label: preparing
what: Preliminary planning to furnish the inn for guest lodging: innkeeper and neighbour jointly inspected for beds and sleeping space, and arranged inquiries about beds, suppliers and itemized furnishing prices. Builder knowingly helped by checking workshops for suppliers and quotes. No beds were ordered, no supplier or prices confirmed, and no purchases or work authorized. The shown record does not show the mayor being told of this furnishing preparation, but does not establish deliberate secrecy or rule out unlogged notification.
